method: Actual-input reports with unique run ID only. Search-and-extract means one or more actually collected remains and successful return; does not assert alternate-route, visual, prepared-value or independent player review. Deaths/empty exits stay as attempts. Old r2 low/medium is listed separately, never automatically promoted to r3.
contractScope: Each world requires actual search-and-return evidence; separate normal-view grade/seed matrix, continuous supply and prepared comparisons are different denominators. Cell counts here do not impose two full journeys for every world-grade.
